evidence.description: Allowlist now enumerates all 5 MVP platforms named in REQ-G2 MVP scope (behavioral-spec.md:578-589): coconala, whop, amazon_associates, youtube_adsense, algora. Each entry carries the required field set (endpoint, method, response_format, receipt_id_path, amount_path, payer_path, unit, comparison). FIND-2-003 closed.

Scope-cut table at lines 945-959 enumerates 13 deferred findings (FIND-002/003/004/005/006/007/008/010/012/014/015/017/018), each with a concrete sprint-2 acceptance criterion citing a specific file/module. The 8 items the iter-2 manifest declared as silently incomplete are all listed. FIND-2-004 closed.

EDGE-1..EDGE-10 enumerated including EDGE-8 STALE_FIRST_PASS grace, EDGE-9 disk-full claim-check tentative-row recovery, EDGE-10 stale-in-progress reversion. Scope-cut table commits sprint-2 fixture coverage for empty-verdict (FIND-008), MOTHER queue read-only (FIND-014), and PROP-tests (FIND-017).

Lines 22-37 export ANICCA_PANE_TEXT (etc.) as env vars; line 40 execs python3 against a static-path script — NO heredoc interpolation. Untrusted tmux pane bytes flow into os.environ only (kernel-mediated bytes, not parsed as source). FIND-2-001 critical RCE surface closed for healthcheck path.

Lines 9-15 export 6 numeric/string args as ANICCA_* env vars; line 17 execs python3 against static path. No string interpolation of $TOKENS_IN/$MODEL_ID into Python source. FIND-2-001 closed for roi path.

Lines 12-15 export slot/reason/evidence as env vars; line 20 execs python3 dispatch script. REQ-F1 evidence (potentially externally-influenced) reaches Python as os.environ value, never parsed as code. FIND-2-001 closed for self-recover path.

Lines 9-13 export req_id/outcome/body-file as env vars; line 15 execs python3 dispatch. REQ-D2 dedup-check uses Python equality on env-string vs JSON-decoded field — no source-level injection surface. FIND-2-001 closed for cross-learn path.

Lines 60-64 carry two complementary regex rules: the command-line form (`--label\s*[=]?\s*['"]?escalation['"]?`) AND the Python list-literal form (`['"]--label['"]\s*,\s*['"]escalation['"]`). The second rule catches subprocess.run([..., '--label', 'escalation']) — verified by inspection (quote+--label+quote, comma+optional-space, quote+escalation+quote). FIND-2-005 closed.

Clean separation: shell snapshots state → env, Python dispatch reads env, calls pure lib.healthcheck.classify(ctx). Per-script ~50 lines, single-purpose, sys.path bootstrapping via ANICCA_SHARED_DIR is uniform across all 4 -dispatch.py files.

RATES_INPUT/RATES_OUTPUT centralized at module top (lines 18-23); pure lib.roi.compute_token_cost_jpy called with typed dict; result appended via shared lib._common.append_jsonl. No duplication with the .sh wrapper.

Contains `3kVjAfM7r8IVJjqIXcg7L0r/wHv4WhBN+0/o/eOtPI4=` — 44 base64 chars (43 + 1 pad) decoding to exactly 32 bytes per REQ-E5 (base64-encoded raw ed25519 pubkey). REQ-E5 precondition (`base64.b64decode(...) length == 32`) now passes. FIND-2-002 closed for the placeholder-decode-failure surface; the spec scope-cut row for FIND-015 commits the real keypair + nacl.signing verify to sprint-2.

Purity Boundary section (lines 967-975) keeps PURE layer enumerated (classify, roi.compute, kill_switch_tripped, novelty-quota, rolling-window, manifest field validation, escalate.dedup_key/normalize_evidence); I/O-BOUND layer enumerated separately. The 4 new -dispatch.py files match this boundary: they do env-read + io-glue only, never inline pure logic.
